description: baseline (default config: GRU hs64 proj32 drop0.3 lr1e-3 wd0.01 bs32 ep853/2000)
exp1: proj_dim 32->64 (worse, more overfit)
exp2: dropout 0.3->0.5 (worse, over-regularized)
exp3: label_smoothing 0.1 in cross-entropy (val~same, test up)
exp4: bidirectional GRU (val up but test down, anti-correlated)
exp5: mixup alpha=0.2 + label_smoothing 0.1 (val+test up, gap narrowed)
exp6: cosine LR T_max1500 + mixup0.2 + LS0.1 (big jump, flat minimum)
exp7: hidden_size 64->128 (overfits even w/ reg stack, val down)
exp8: mixup alpha 0.4 (over-mixed; val>test flipped, test down)
exp9: decode window 50-350ms (negligible +0.0002, not worth extra compute)
exp10: weight_decay 0.01->0.05 (val+test up, strong reg helps)
exp11: weight_decay 0.1 (over-regularized, too much)
exp12: dropout 0.4 (slightly worse, stack already well-regularized)
exp13: lr 0.002 (slightly too high, val down)
exp14: aux deep-supervision loss w=0.3 on earlier steps (big jump)
exp15: aux_weight 0.5 (over-weights earlier steps; test opt is lower)
exp16: aux_weight 0.2 (worse than 0.3; 0.3 is the peak)
exp17: proj_dim 16 (too tight, underfits; 32 is the sweet spot)
exp18: label_smoothing 0.2 (too much; 0.1 is the sweet spot)
exp19: 2-layer GRU (depth overfits; single-layer best)
exp20: select final-epoch weights (escapes val-spike; test up, val same)
exp21: lr_t_max 1750 full anneal (final-point selection is schedule-sensitive)
exp22: SWA weight averaging swa_start=1000 (robust select, best yet)
exp23: swa_start 700 (marginally worse; 1000 is the sweet spot)
exp24: channel masking 0.1 (removes too much signal from pre-selected channels)
exp25: mixup 0.3 (over-mixes; 0.2 is the sweet spot)
exp26: lr 0.0007 (undertrains; 0.001 is the sweet spot)
exp27: patience 800 (more SWA pts but rising-LR tail adds noise)
exp28: weight_decay 0.07 (over-reg; val up/test down, 0.05 optimal)
exp29: swa_start 1200 (worse; 1000 is the peak)
exp30: grad clip 1.0 (restricts optimization; hurts test)
exp31: aux late-step weighting (hurt; early-step aux is the valuable part)
exp32: aux early-step weighting (also worse than uniform; uniform aux 0.3 is the peak)
